profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Stripe
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Introduced support and serverless rendering of dynamic HTML templates using Liquid.
Designed and implemented event-driven architecture across 7 internal services.
Executed a complete rebuild of a core ETL data pipeline utilizing AWS Glue and Redshift.
Developed a microservice that interacts with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud utilizing JWT.
Lead development of Poplar Lookalike Modeling, Geofence and Promo Code features.
Migrated all Ruby codebases to Ruby 3 while also reducing test suite run time by 80%.
Maintained a repository of Dockerfiles, ensuring SOC 2 compliance of vulnerabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated the largest monolith from Rails 4 to 5 while incrementing Ruby versions.
Increased unit test coverage for Sidekiq jobs by over 40%.
Removed a legacy telephony provider while maintaining 100% uptime.
Dockerized 3 microservices and established infrastructure as code using Terraform.
Built internal tooling that streams command output from remote containers without SSH.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed the Digital Publishing Platform for English and Spanish brochures.
Coordinated with designers to build Flash / HTML5 banners distributed nationwide.
Developed and launched an award-winning game spotlighting energy-saving LED bulbs.
Tasked with the migration of IKEA Español from another agency to AWS.
Led the conversion of a legacy PHP / Microsoft SQL app to Ruby on Rails / PostgreSQL.
Developed an ERP suite consisting of five microservices used by 100+ employees daily.
Designed and developed MailR, a WYSIWYG HTML email generator with SSO integration.
